_note: Copy to eval/field/ocr/labels.json (git-ignored, with the images) for real slips from the consented field study (docs/field-validation-protocol.md). One item per slip. 'expect' is what is written on the slip, typed by a person who checked it against the paper: medicines as 'Name strength' (unit only when it is not mg, e.g. 'Ascoril LS 5 ml'), the Regn No without spaces, the doctor as 'Dr. First Last', the date as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave a field out when the slip does not show it. Never put patient names here.
